title: Home guide and safety card: the bread mould bag
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Living things and their habitats (Frozen Kingdom)
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 12 (Home practical guide and safety card: bread mould bag (portal worksheet; never open the bag, adult disposes of it sealed))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Observe how mould (a fungus) grows on bread.
safety: NEVER open the bag once it is sealed: mould spores can make people ill
An adult throws the bag away, still sealed, at the end
Keep it away from food and from anyone with asthma
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Sprinkle a few drops of water on the bread.
Put it in the bag and seal it. Tape over the seal.
Label the bag 'Do not open' with the date.
Put it somewhere warm and dark.
Draw it on day 1, then every 2 or 3 days.
practical.adult: An adult seals the bag and disposes of it sealed.
